visualCharacteristics.purpose: Category shortcut slider with circular images and labels
visualCharacteristics.summary: Multi-item slider of circular images with text label below
visualCharacteristics.layout: Many small items per view (about 4 on mobile, 6 on tablet, 8 on desktop); circular cropped image with a text label below; side arrows

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image (cropped to a circle); cell 2: label link (or label text plus a link). One link makes the whole item clickable
contentPattern.source: 13 circular category images + text links (Men, Women, Offer, Couple, Vetra, Mag By Titan, Smart, Bestsellers, Clocks, Kids, Premium, New Arrivals, Raga)

reuseGuidance: Use for compact round category shortcuts. For rectangular tiles use carousel-tiles.
implementationNotes: Shares the carousel engine in /scripts/carousel.js (prev/next, indicators, keyboard arrows, ARIA, autoplay with pause control) and helpers in /scripts/block-utils.js.
